cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Acknowledge Our History
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you bin our ferry ticket, remember the overtime we worked for that weekend. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We missed the ferry. I hate being reminded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We stayed anyway. That was the first time we chose each other over a refund.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep the hotel receipt, then. That part was lovely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you write that on the envelope? In your handwriting, so it isn't just me saying it mattered.

mechanism: A directs memory sorting but yields the painful souvenir in exchange for B own written acknowledgment that the shared choice mattered.
confusable: Unlike nostalgia hoarding, the object can change; borrowed authority organizes B preferred reminder to obtain acknowledgment rather than mere storage.
comparison: Replacing a painful ferry ticket with a hotel receipt differs from explaining a low-yield gardening photo publicly.
seedUse: Use D81-b ticket/overtime/hotel receipt/envelope and S02-b flexible means beneath confident direction.
